title: Minecart Chunkload
description: Minecarts and all variants can toggle chunkload capability.
body:
- Chest Minecarts, Hopper Minecarts, Furnace Minecarts, TNT Minecarts, and Base Minecarts all can be toggled to chunkload with a book or running a command.
- Only loads the chunk it is in.
- Chunks unload when quitting the game.
